questions.question: In December 2017, Mid-Term Review of the Foreign Trade Policy (FTP) was released. The review announced how much percent increase each in incentive rates of Merchandise Exports from India Scheme and Services Export from India Scheme?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**2%.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Export incentives under Merchandise Exports from India (MEIS) have been increased by** 2 percent **across the board for labor-intensive MSME sectors leading to the additional annual incentive of **Rs. 4,567 crores.**
 
• This is in addition to the already announced increase in MEIS incentives from 2 percent to 4 percent for Ready-made Garments Made Ups in the labour intensive Textiles Sector with an additional annual incentive of Rs. 2,743 crores Further, incentives under the Services Exports from India Scheme (SEIS) have also been increases by 2% percent leading to an additional annual incentive of Rs. 1,140 crores.

questions.question: The Union Cabinet, in Aug 2022, approved the enhancement in the limit of Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS) by ________ , with the additional amount being earmarked exclusively for enterprises in hospitality and related sectors.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **__50,000 crore.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Emergency Credit Line Guarantee Scheme (ECLGS) a part of the Atma Nirbhar Bharat Package in 2020
 
• Its objective is to help businesses including MSMEs to meet their operational liabilities and resume businesses the hit caused by the COVID-19 crisis.
 
• It provides Member Lending Institutions (MLIs), 100 percent guarantee against any losses suffered by them due to non-repayment of the ECLGS funding by borrowers.
 
• The overall ceiling initially was Rs 3 lakh crore which was increased to Rs 4.5 lakh crore.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ECLGS is under Department of Financial Services (DFS) in the Ministry of Finance.
 
• The R.O.I. is 9.25 percent for Banks and Financial Institutions and 14 percent for Non-Banking Financial Institutions.
 
• Loans under the ECLGS are collateral-free, backed by a government guarantee.
 
• The scheme is implemented through various scheduled commercial banks, financial institutions, and Non-Banking Financial Companies (NBFCs).

questions.question: In Budget 2022-23,Government of India decided to continue the Scheme of ‘Khelo India – National Programme for Development of Sports’ over the 15th Finance Commission Cycle (2021-22 to 2025-26) at an outlay of________.

questions.question: ‘Protocol for Star Rating of Garbage-Free Cities’ launched on January 20, 2018 will be rating cities on ________ rating system.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**7-star.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **‘Protocol for Star Rating of Garbage-Free Cities**’ launched on **January 20, 2018,** will be rating cities on a **7-star rating system.**
 
• It aims to achieve garbage-free status leading to a **higher degree of cleanliness.**
 
• Each ward in every city must achieve a certain standard across** 24 different components of Solid Waste Management (SWM)** and is graded based on overall marks received.
 
• The system is based on multiple cleanliness indicators for solid waste management which comprise** bulk generator compliance, door-to-door collection, sweeping, source segregation, plastic waste management, scientific processing of waste, construction management, and more.**

questions.question: Which from following unemployment scheme was extended by the government of India for a period of two years from July 2022 to June 2024?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana** was extended by the Government of India for a period of two years from July 2022 to June 2024.
 
• This scheme is aimed at providing financial assistance to unemployed individuals who have lost their jobs due to various reasons.
 
• The scheme is implemented by the Employees' State Insurance Corporation (ESIC) and provides relief to workers covered under the ESI scheme.
 
• Under this scheme, eligible unemployed individuals receive a cash benefit for up to 90 days during their unemployment period.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Atal Beemit Vyakti Kalyan Yojana** was initially introduced in 2018 as a pilot scheme for two years.
 
• The scheme was extended for the first time from July 2020 to June 2022 before the latest extension.
 
• To avail the benefits, the unemployed individual must have been in insurable employment for a minimum of two years.
 
• The individual must have contributed to the ESI scheme for at least 78 days in each of the four contribution periods immediately preceding the unemployment.
 
• This scheme is part of the government’s efforts to provide social security to workers in the organized sector.
 
• The financial assistance provided under the scheme is equivalent to 50% of the average daily earnings of the individual.

questions.question: The Maritime Anti-Piracy Act, 2022, received the assent of the President on ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Tue Jan 31 2023 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Maritime Anti-Piracy Act, 2022** received the assent of the President on **Tue Jan 31 2023 00:00:00 GMT+0530 (India Standard Time)**.
 
• The Act aims to provide an effective legal framework to combat piracy and ensure the safety and security of maritime trade routes.
 
• It defines piracy and prescribes stringent punishments for those involved in such activities.
 
• The Act aligns with India's commitment to international conventions and treaties on maritime safety and security.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Piracy** is defined under the Act as any illegal act of violence, detention, or depredation committed for private ends by the crew or passengers of a private ship or aircraft, and directed on the high seas against another ship or aircraft, or against persons or property on board such ship or aircraft.
 
• The Act extends to the Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) of India and applies to all persons irrespective of their nationality.
 
• The legislation also provides for the establishment of designated courts for the speedy trial of piracy-related offenses.

questions.question: The 'SAKSHAM' campaign launched by the Government of India in January 2021 aims to spread awareness about ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**adoption of cleaner fuels.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• SAKSHAM__ is the name of the campaign launched by the Petroleum Conservation Research Association to spread awareness about ‘Green and Clean Energy'.
 
• The month-long campaign highlights the adverse health and environmental impacts of increasing carbon footprints.
 
• The idea of the SAKSHAM is to convince consumers to switch to cleaner fuels and bring in behavioural change to use fossil fuel intelligently.
 
• The campaign activities include cyclotron, farmer workshops, seminars, painting competitions, CNG vehicle driving contests, etc.
 
• The campaign will spread awareness about seven key drivers-
 __
 
• moving towards a gas-based economy
 
• **cleaner use of fossil fuels**
 
• greater reliance on domestic sources to drive bio-fuels
 
• achieving renewable targets with the set deadlines
 
• increased use of electric vehicles to decarbonize mobility
 
• increased use of cleaner fuels like Hydrogen
 
• digital innovation across all energy systems
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9074044cf96dc1d09ca89eac99180c3d7440ade1b364d09d47931959bf693cc8.png] **Confusion Points__**

 
• A total of 152 Centre for Financial Literacy and Service Delivery** (SAKSHAM Centres)** across 77 districts of 13 states were launched under Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana - National Rural Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NRLM) in October 2021.
